seoTitle: DNS Answer Comparer: Compare Two dig Results After a DNS Change
metaDescription: Paste dig or nslookup answers from two resolvers or from before and after a change. See which records match, differ and have different TTLs.
intro: Compares two sets of DNS records and shows what is the same, what is only in one answer and where the TTL differs. Useful after a DNS change or migration.
why:
After a DNS change, different resolvers answer differently until caches expire. Running dig against two resolvers and comparing by eye is slow and error-prone, especially with several records.

This page does not look anything up. Run dig yourself, for example dig @8.8.8.8 example.com A and dig @1.1.1.1 example.com A, and paste both. Records are compared as sets, ignoring order and a trailing dot. Round-robin or geo DNS can differ legitimately.
howTo: Run dig against resolver A and paste the answer in the first box.
Do the same for resolver B.
Read the verdict and the lists.
Wait for the TTL to pass and compare again.

faq.a: Full dig answer lines (name TTL IN TYPE value), lines without TTL, and bare TYPE value lines.
